fileNames.description: The uploaded files in the source collection

localSourceCollection.description:
The associated local source collection.
The json object has the structure of {@link SourceCollection}.

localSource.description:
The source type metadata associated to local version of the source collection.
The json object has the structure of {@link TypeMeta}.

remoteSource.description:
The source type metadata associated to remote version of the source collection.
The json object has the structure of {@link TypeMeta}.

location.description: The location of the source system collection.

localSourceMismatchAgainstRemote.description:
Map of all the mismatches for a local collection against the remote collection with the same name.
The map key is the field name.

schemaTypeMeta.description: Data used for the schema preview tab

failedToLoad.description: Whether there was a failure to load this schema cache item
